A '''training commandant''', also known as a '''Commandant''', was the title given to combat instructors among the [[Imperial Guard]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Guardsmen were appointed training commandants if they reached the age where they were no longer fit for active duty, and they served at academies on worlds such as [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].
